shared_elements: rows/groups of figures facing the same direction
scene divided into stacked horizontal registers
justification: Both surfaces show multiple standing human figures in profile, grouped in rows and stacked in horizontal registers separated by framing lines, with a conveyance included in the upper zone (wheeled vehicle in A, sailing vessel in B). But the depictive conventions differ sharply: A is a modelled, naturalistic low-relief procession of individualised, similarly-costumed attendants advancing in a single direction, while B is a flat silhouette/outline composition with schematic angular figures, a mast-and-sail motif and a plaited interlace border that has no counterpart in A.
